params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $repo=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'HeavenBridgeRepo'; $tmp=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'HeavenBridge\verify-priority-1054'; git -C $repo fetch origin main; if (Test-Path $tmp) { git -C $repo worktree remove --force $tmp 2>$null; if (Test-Path $tmp) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $tmp } }; git -C $repo worktree add --detach $tmp origin/main; try { Set-Location $tmp; $sha=(git rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); Write-Output "VERIFY_SHA=$sha"; python -m py_compile .\heaven-bridge\worker.py; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; python .\heaven-bridge\test_worker.py; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; python .\heaven-bridge\tests\test_worker.py; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git diff --check; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Output 'PRIORITY_GATE_OK' } finally { Set-Location $env:USERPROFILE; git -C $repo worktree remove --force $tmp 2>$null }
